concerns.text: Unit test T012 for entropy calculation is listed before the producer task T045 (`code/metrics.py::calculate_shannon_entropy`) that implements the entropy function, violating the producer‑before‑consumer rule.
Task T018 (diversity‑score functions) depends on the category‑merging routine defined in T050, but T050 is scheduled later in the same phase, creating a consumer‑before‑producer ordering error.
Unit test T029 for the residual permutation routine is placed before the implementation task T031 that defines `run_residual_permutation`, resulting in a consumer‑before‑producer violation.
